message: Last week, we had a little power outage, and let me tell you, it was quite the comedy show! I fumbled around in the dark, looking for my trusty flashlight, only to find it dead as a doornail. After a few moments of wrestling with a dying phone and a half-eaten bag of chips for dinner, I realized I really should have been a bit more prepared! Now, I’m on a mission to gather some reliable flashlights and power banks for next time. Have you had any funny moments like that when things didn’t quite go as planned?
